description.value: The U'mista Cultural Centre in Alert Bay is a nationally significant First Nations museum dedicated to preserving the cultural heritage of the Kwakwaka'wakw people, including the celebrated Potlatch Collection of ceremonial regalia. Visitor reviews describe it as one of the finest small museums in existence, with well-organized exhibits and powerful historical context. Cyclists reaching Alert Bay by ferry will find guided tours, artist demonstrations, and a gift shop selling authentic Indigenous art.
